title: Subjective Meanings of Modal Verbs
summary: Using modal verbs to report claims and express degrees of probability.
whyItMatters: Subjective modal verbs let speakers mark whether information is reported, highly probable, merely possible, or doubtful.

mentalModel.title: Modal verbs can evaluate information
mentalModel.content: Beyond ability or obligation, müssen, dürften, mögen, sollen, and wollen can express a speaker's stance toward a claim.

mentalModel.title: Source and probability are different
mentalModel.content: Sollen and wollen often attribute information; müssen and dürften usually estimate likelihood.

ruleBlocks.title: Express probability
ruleBlocks.content: Use müssen for a strong inference, dürften for high probability, and können or mögen for possibility.

ruleBlocks.title: Mark reported claims
ruleBlocks.content: Use sollen for claims by others and wollen for a subject's claim about itself.

ruleBlocks.title: Refer to past events
ruleBlocks.content: Use modal verb plus past infinitive: Er muss die Daten gelöscht haben.

examples.de: Die Einstellung muss nach dem Update verändert worden sein.
examples.en: The setting must have been changed after the update.

examples.de: Der Dienst soll Standortdaten an Dritte weitergegeben haben.
examples.en: The service is reported to have shared location data with third parties.

examples.de: Der Anbieter will alle betroffenen Konten informiert haben.
examples.en: The provider claims to have informed all affected accounts.

commonMistakes.wrong: Interpret sollen in every sentence as obligation.
commonMistakes.correct: Check whether the sentence reports an external claim.
commonMistakes.reason: Context determines objective or subjective meaning.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use a present infinitive for a past inference.
commonMistakes.correct: Use a past infinitive such as gemacht haben or passiert sein.
commonMistakes.reason: The infinitive carries the time relationship.

comparisons.summary: Legal and digital-rights discussions require careful separation of evidence and allegation.
Complaints should mark uncertain information instead of presenting assumptions as established facts.
